sets.title: Quick Quiz
sets.description: Choose the correct adverb or adjective form
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите правильную форму наречия или прилагательного

items.promptEnglish: The teacher explains the lesson very clearly.
items.hint: Describes HOW the teacher explains (verb), not a noun.
items.explanation: Use the adverb понятно (clearly/understandably) with the verb объясняет. Понятный is an adjective.
Быстро (quickly) is an adverb describing the verb едет. Быстрый is an adjective.

items.promptEnglish: Tomorrow we will go to the museum.
items.explanation: Завтра (tomorrow) matches the future tense пойдём (we will go).

items.hint: 'Far away' is the opposite of близко.
items.explanation: Далеко (far away) is a place adverb. Близко means 'nearby.'

minimalPairs.explanation: Use the adjective хороший to describe the noun фильм. Хорошо is an adverb for verbs.
Use the adverb быстро to describe how she reads. Быстрая is a feminine adjective.
Быстрая is a feminine adjective matching машина. Быстро is an adverb for verbs.
Use the adverb плохо to describe how he works. Плохой is an adjective.

sets.title: Fill and Sort
sets.description: Fill in the right adverb and sort adverbs by type
sets.descriptionRussian: Вставьте нужное наречие и рассортируйте наречия по типу

fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Choosing the right adverb for the context.
explanations: Громко (loudly) describes how the children play.
Вчера (yesterday) matches the past tense ходил (went).
Близко (nearby) is a place adverb telling where.

yesterday = вчера, he was = он был, here = здесь

sets.title: Spot the Errors
sets.description: Find where an adjective was used instead of an adverb (or vice versa)
sets.descriptionRussian: Найдите, где прилагательное использовано вместо наречия (или наоборот)

errorCorrection.hint: Describes how he reads (a verb), not a noun.
errorCorrection.explanation: Use the adverb медленно (slowly) with the verb читает. Медленный is an adjective.

errorCorrection.hint: Describes how she cooks, not a noun.
errorCorrection.explanation: Use the adverb вкусно (deliciously) with the verb готовит. Вкусный is an adjective.

errorCorrection.hint: Describes the noun день, not a verb.
errorCorrection.explanation: Use the adjective плохой to describe the noun день. Плохо is an adverb for verbs.

errorCorrection.hint: Describes how she sings, not a noun.
errorCorrection.explanation: Use the adverb громко (loudly) with the verb поёт. Громкий is an adjective.

items.promptEnglish: Which word is an adverb (describes a verb)?
items.hint: Adverbs often end in -о and describe verbs.
items.explanation: Хорошо (well) is an adverb. The others are adjectives describing nouns.

items.promptEnglish: The children listen to the teacher attentively.
items.explanation: Внимательно (attentively) is the adverb form. It describes the verb слушают.

items.promptEnglish: My friend comes to work early.
items.explanation: Рано (early) is a time adverb. Поздно means 'late.'

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: A mixed challenge covering all adverb types and uses
sets.descriptionRussian: Смешанное задание по всем типам наречий и их использованию

patternRecognition.sentence: хорошо, плохо, быстро, медленно, тихо, громко
patternRecognition.question: What do these words have in common?
options: They are all manner adverbs ending in -о
patternRecognition.answer: They are all manner adverbs ending in -о
patternRecognition.explanation: These are manner adverbs answering 'how?' They all end in -о and describe verbs.

patternRecognition.sentence: хороший - хорошо, быстрый - быстро, плохой - плохо
patternRecognition.question: What is the pattern for turning adjectives into adverbs?
options: Adjectives and adverbs are always the same
patternRecognition.explanation: To make a manner adverb, replace the adjective ending (-ый/-ий/-ой) with -о: хороший -> хорошо.

patternRecognition.sentence: сегодня, завтра, вчера, сейчас, рано, поздно
patternRecognition.question: What type of adverbs are these?
patternRecognition.explanation: These all answer the question 'when?': today, tomorrow, yesterday, now, early, late.

minimalPairs.explanation: Use the adjective красивая to describe the noun музыка. Красиво is an adverb.
Use the adverb аккуратно to describe how he writes. Аккуратный is an adjective.
Use the adverb спокойно to describe how the cat sleeps. Спокойный is an adjective.

fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Time, place, and manner adverbs in context.
explanations: Вчера (yesterday) matches the past tense были.
Далеко (far) is a place adverb. He lives far from work.
